title: Flung forth a coin over the area railings. It fell on the path.
html_source:
As this woman throws a coin down it falls to the ground. This is a commentary on distribution of wealth. Those who have are apt to waste while those in need are forced to beg.

Gold or wealth is seen in several other sections of this Episode.
